notes.title: Oops! You're the Hero! Final Demo: Patch 2
notes.content:

[/p][p][b]✨VISUALS:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Adjustment of VFX indicator Tut’s beginning dialogue in the temple area[/p][/*][*][p]VFX indicator of the Wizard spilling liquid on the Thief[/p][/*][*][p]Volume Control Slider added [/p][/*][*][p]Pause Menu UI updated [/p][/*][/list][p]

[/p]

notes.title: Oops! You're the Hero! Demo Update
notes.content:
[h1][u][b]Announcement![/b][/u][/h1]

The newest demo for 'Oops! You're the Hero!' has been released! There have been quite a few changes: 
[list]
[*][i]All music has been redone and added [/i]
[*] [i] Explosive Barrels are now present and effect enemies [/i]
[*] [i]Multiple pathways to get through the levels, both violent and passive [/i]
[*] [i] Rope mechanic has been added to swing across platforms[/i]
[/list]

[b][u][h1]Next Steps Will Include[/h1][/u][/b]
[list]
[*] [i]Continued Bug Fixes [/i]
[*] [i]Creating a Mac build[/i]
[*] [i]Polishing Rope mechanic[/i]
[*] [i]Visual updates[/i]
[/list]

Thank you for being patient, and for playing!

notes.title: Oops! You're the Hero! Demo - Patch 1
notes.content:
[h1][u][b]Announcement![/b][/u][/h1]

A week has passed since the release of the game's demo! There have been a few issues found, so this past week has been tackling bugs and some polish. The first patch for 'Oops! You're the Hero!' is live! This includes: 
[list]
[*][i]Updated lighting settings[/i]
[*] [i]Fixed bug in the Main Menu concerning the mouse and button selection [/i]
[*] [i]Fixed bug concerning the Pause Menu and restarting the game[/i]
[*] [i]Added a Loading Screen for easier transition between Menus and Demo Level[/i]
[/list]

[b][u][h1]Next Steps Will Include[/h1][/u][/b]
[list]
[*] [i]Continued Bug Fixes [/i]
[*] [i]Creating a Mac build[/i]
[*] [i]Roadmap Creation for Upcoming Demo Updates, including final Demo Build [/i]
[/list]

Thank you for being patient, and for playing!
